objective.statement: Design a bounded worker lifecycle whose owned resources are observable and reclaimable.

assumptions.statement: The target host exposes a delegated unified cgroup hierarchy.
assumptions.falsifier: Run the target-host cgroup controller and delegation probe.

unknowns.statement: Controller delegation on the target host has not been observed.
unknowns.discovery_method: Execute the target-host capability probe under the intended service identity.
unknowns.impact: Blocks privileged implementation while allowing design and pure-logic scaffolding.

realms.authority: owns admission, resource boundaries, observation, and cleanup
exit_conditions: all owned resources are absent and a terminal receipt exists

realms.authority: may consume only explicitly assigned resources
exit_conditions: payload has stopped and no descendant remains

boundaries.mechanism: supervisor-owned process and resource boundary selected by the domain implementation

flows.payload: one lifecycle command with transferred execution ownership
flows.backpressure: one in-flight command; producer blocks or rejects
flows.failure_semantics: partial delivery is rejected and reconciliation observes the last committed state

postconditions: one resource boundary exists and is observable
worker is observable inside the boundary

transitions.trigger: worker or supervisor failure is observed
postconditions: cleanup actuator owns the resource boundary

invariants.statement: A worker cannot enter RUNNING before its resource boundary is attached.
invariants.enforcement: start barrier is released only after boundary attachment

oracle.procedure: Observe the state transition receipt and resource membership before T-START.
oracle.pass_condition: Every RUNNING observation has an earlier matching boundary-attachment receipt.

invariants.enforcement: T-RELEASE and T-REAP require a zero-resource observation

oracle.procedure: Enumerate the allocation's owned resources after terminal state.
oracle.pass_condition: The enumeration is empty and remains empty across one observation interval.

capabilities.statement: The intended service identity can create, configure, observe, and remove the required cgroup boundary.

probe.procedure: Run a bounded create-configure-attach-observe-remove probe on the target host.
probe.pass_condition: Every operation succeeds and the test cgroup is absent after cleanup.

capabilities.consequence_if_absent: Only design and non-privileged prototype work may proceed.

resources.enforcement: admission ledger and substrate resource controller
resources.exceed_action: reject the second allocation and record RESOURCE_LIMIT

failures.fault: supervisor stops after allocation but before normal release
failures.detection: external watchdog observes control-plane loss and owned resource presence
failures.containment: admission remains closed for the allocation
failures.reconciliation: take cleanup ownership, stop descendants, wait empty, remove, verify

oracle.procedure: Inject supervisor termination at each lifecycle barrier and inspect owned resources.
oracle.pass_condition: Every run reaches TERMINATED with zero owned resources.

leak_oracle.procedure: Enumerate all resources tagged with the allocation identity.
leak_oracle.pass_condition: No tagged resource exists after normal or crash teardown.

reconciliation_loops.desired_state: TERMINATED with zero owned resources and closed admission
reconciliation_loops.diff: Compare observed state and inventory with the desired terminal tuple.
reconciliation_loops.actuator: stop descendants, wait for empty state, remove owned resources, verify absence
reconciliation_loops.convergence: terminal tuple is observed twice without new owned resources
reconciliation_loops.stop_condition: three bounded attempts, no progress, or a Human-owned destructive boundary

preconditions: the exact JSON contract is available

oracle.procedure: Execute check_system_contract.py against the exact fixture.
oracle.pass_condition: The checker exits 0 and reports the expected subject and gate.

verification.negative_control: remove one invariant oracle and require exit 2

oracle.procedure: Observe resource membership, state transitions, and post-run inventory.
oracle.pass_condition: The lifecycle reaches TERMINATED with zero owned resources.

verification.negative_control: skip crash cleanup and require the leak oracle to fail

implementation_gate.rationale: The contract is closed, but the required privileged substrate capability has not been exercised.
